findings.message: `os.path.splitext(f)[1] != ""` also drops shebang scripts with no suffix — `scripts/aegis/aegis` here, adopters' `bin/*`. A diff touching only such a file passes the testing mandate with no test change; exposure is low because every fixture test execs that entrypoint and the gate runs `make test`.
findings.minimal_fix: keep a no-suffix file as code when it starts with `#!`
